_doc: R62 — the news wire's copy. Every sentence the wire prints lives here, keyed by EVENT id; engine modules emit {event, params} and never a sentence. Before this file, 17 player-facing lines were written inside campaign.js and rehab.js, so a new world-reaction was an engine edit — against CLAUDE.md's 'all content is data'. `lines` is the pool for an event: one is picked with the seeded RNG, so a save always tells its story the same way and a reload mid-run cannot reroll the wire. `by` is an optional per-philosophy pool, checked first, which is how the world reacts differently to a Naturalist than to an Engineer — the same machinery R10 built for the rivals, pointed at the campaign instead. Placeholders are {braces} filled by campaign/monologue.js `fill`, which leaves an unknown key ALONE rather than printing 'undefined', so a typo reads oddly instead of breaking. Adding a reaction is a key here plus one emit at the site of the event; it must never be an engine change again. The gate in tools/smoke.js runs the invariant both ways: every event emitted in code has copy here, and every event here has an emitter — R20's rule, pointed at the wire.

lines: THE COUNTY IS YOURS. All {nodes} nodes held.{rivals} Somewhere, a regional manager is updating a spreadsheet with shaking hands.
THE COUNTY IS YOURS. Every one of {nodes} nodes answers to the lab.{rivals} The county line is now a suggestion you make.
The coalition does not concede. It reschedules. Counter-offensives continue.
The coalition has stopped calling it a war and started calling it a quarterly review. It continues.
Sparring session concluded. The garrison applauds politely and re-chalks the ring.
Sparring session concluded. Somebody fetches the good chalk.
Sparring session concluded. No territory changed hands and everyone had a nice time.
{creature} has been transferred to an out-of-state research internship (involuntary). The enemy took notes.
{creature} rescued from the impound lot! Bond deepened. Paperwork ignored.
{creature} is home from the impound lot, furious and adored. Nobody signed anything.
THE GAUNTLET IS CLEARED. The coalition has nothing left in storage. Somewhere, a procurement officer starts a very long memo.
{node} seized. Income +${income}/day. Locals adjusting surprisingly well.
{node} seized. Income +${income}/day. The locals have decided this is fine.
{node} changes hands. +${income}/day, and nobody has filed anything about it.

naturalist: {node} seized. Income +${income}/day. Taken with clean stock and cleaner records.
engineer: {node} seized. Income +${income}/day. Witnesses disagree about how many legs were involved.

lines: {announce}
Salvage crews work through the night at {node}. One {unit} is now, legally speaking, scrap you own.
Salvage crews strip {node} until dawn. One {unit} is yours, in the way a paperweight is yours.
{creature} CAPTURED! "Unauthorized peer review" scheduled in {hours}h. Mount a rescue.
{creature} CAPTURED! They have booked "unauthorized peer review" for {hours}h from now. There is still time.
{creature} is the last one on the roster, and the coalition could not quite hold on to it. It limped back through the fence at dawn, furious and filthy. Infirmary.
{unit} dismantled with great enthusiasm. Enemy tech acquired.
{unit} taken apart on the workshop floor. The parts are ours and the manual is missing.
{creature} has been enrolled in a private behavioural programme. Its former employer has not been notified.
{creature} starts a private behavioural programme today. Nobody has told its old employer.
{creature} graduates the Reorientation Wing and reports for duty, cautiously.
{creature} graduates the Reorientation Wing with honours and follows you around the yard.
{creature} completes the programme unsupervised and joins the roster. It is watching you. Always watching.
BREAKOUT: {lab} confirms one specimen is unaccounted for. It was last seen {sighting}. The lab describes the situation as “fluid.”
{lab} has misplaced a chimera. It is {sighting} and it is not coming when called.
A specimen belonging to {lab} was reported {sighting} this morning. The county has been advised to carry on normally.
THWOOMP. {creature} is off the streets and into a bay. {lab} has been sent an invoice for the inconvenience.
{creature} has been impounded. {lab} is welcome to file a claim and will be ignored politely.
{creature} was talked down, and {lab} collected it in an unmarked van. Everyone waved.
{creature} has been retrieved by {lab}, who arrived with a net and no apology.
